node.statement: For B=direct_sum_(r=1)^m M_(q_r), independently choose in each block a Pauli unitary W_(r,a,b) and a sign sigma_r in {+1,-1}, and average U^dagger tensor U over U=direct_sum_r sigma_r W_(r,a,b). Independent sign averaging kills every cross-block tensor component, while within each block it leaves D_(q_r); hence the average is a diagonal of B. It is a convex combination of U^dagger tensor U with U unitary, so its displayed representation has sum_j||A_j||||B_j||=1, independent of m and all q_r.
